title: Bajta craft
description: The ultimate modpack for having a laugh with friends. Dive into a mix of PvP, adventure, and pure chaos in this feature-rich vanilla-plus world.
body:
**BajtaCraft is a feature-rich "Enhanced Vanilla" modpack that expands Minecraft in every direction without compromising its core feel.**

Discover new creatures, from cute ducks to terrifying Weeping Angels. Explore with aircraft and gliders, build with thousands of new decorative blocks, and challenge yourself with powerful artifacts and new bosses. It seamlessly blends major new content with essential quality-of-life improvements and top-tier performance mods for a stunning, smooth experience.


# Features

🗺️ Exploration & Adventure: New mobs, structures, bosses, and dimensions to discover.

✈️ Transport & Tech: Fly aircraft, drive cars, and automate with advanced machinery.

🏠 Building & Decoration: A massive catalog of new furniture, lights, and decorative blocks.

✨ Visuals & Performance: Enhanced with Iris shader support and optimized for maximum FPS.

⚙️ Quality of Life: Smarter inventory, better UI, and countless gameplay refinements.

BajtaCraft is the ultimate pack for players who want a deeper, more beautiful, and more adventurous Minecraft that still feels like home.
